blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan — Police seized 33 grams of suspected shabu worth P224,400 and arrested a man during a search warrant operation in Bolinao, Pangasinan, on Saturday, Oct. 3. The suspect, a single and unemployed resident of Bolinao, was reportedly on the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency’s Regional Watch List for illegal drugs in Pangasinan. The Philippine National Police Drug Enforcement Group Special Operations Unit 1, along with other police units, implemented Search Warrant No. 41-2026 against the suspect.
